article.body:
Our Yetzer can't stop us, we make the right choice,

simcha! The Torah tells us three times to rejoice, giving us a “chazaka” for joy, allowing our happiness on Sukkos to be

This simcha isn’t just for ourselves—we’re meant to share it with everyone around us. And when we reach Shmini Atzeres and Simchas Torah, our joy grows even more as we rejoice with the Torah. When we’re so full of simcha with the Torah, the Yetzer Hara has no effect—we’re too busy celebrating!
